title: Same-protocol reproduction of communication-efficient private FL comparators
status: frozen before SOTA adapter runs; post-hoc extension after original confirmatory test access
claim_scope: Direct comparisons are valid only for re-runs on the locked PhysioNet cohort, model, privacy budget, CKKS backend, round budget, and paired seeds. They are not reproductions of the source papers' published dataset numbers.

shared_execution.model: two-layer binary MLP with 64 hidden units

transport.client_specific_sparse_support_policy: dense CKKS re-encoding; logical compression is reported separately and no encrypted wire saving is claimed

shared_execution.operating_point: Youden-J selected on pooled validation predictions and frozen before test scoring

methods.source_code_status: No official implementation is linked from the publisher page or paper; paper-faithful Algorithm 1 reimplementation.
adaptations: The sign of the error-feedback state is expressed in local model-delta coordinates, which is algebraically equivalent to Algorithm 1's global-minus-local update.
The source paper is non-private; the frozen record-level DP-SGD mechanism is applied before compression as privacy-preserving post-processing.
Sparse client supports are dense CKKS re-encoded to preserve sum-only encrypted aggregation.

methods.source_code_status: No official implementation is linked from the publisher page or paper; paper-faithful Algorithm 1 reimplementation.
adaptations: The frozen record-level DP-SGD mechanism is applied before compression.
Sparse client supports are dense CKKS re-encoded to preserve sum-only encrypted aggregation.
The negative local DP model delta is used as the gradient-direction surrogate because the common healthcare protocol performs one local epoch.
The paper's local-DP Gaussian mechanism is replaced by the study's frozen patient-level DP-SGD mechanism; no original SoteriaFL LDP claim is transferred.
Example-count weighting replaces the source algorithm's equal client mean to match every healthcare comparator.
Independent random-k supports are dense CKKS re-encoded, so only logical sparse payload reduction is claimed.

methods.source: internal proposed method under the same frozen protocol

analysis.interval: two-sided paired Student-t 95 percent confidence interval
analysis.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the three new comparator-versus-CAABC primary metric families
analysis.missing_cells: No direct superiority claim until all paired cells complete

claim_boundaries: This extension is frozen before the new SOTA runs but after the original test set had already been accessed; it is not a prospective preregistration.
Fed-EF is a paper-faithful reimplementation, not an official-code reproduction.
SoteriaFL's recurrence is official-code verified, but the healthcare DP and encrypted transport adaptations change its original threat model.
Dense CKKS re-encoding of client-specific supports prevents real encrypted wire savings for Fed-EF and SoteriaFL in this sum-only deployment.
No source-paper published number is treated as directly comparable across datasets.
